line.comment: * Herobetty 5.4: Clean up the predetermined black market ship arrays. No longer needed at this point, if the player didn't join the OCV at this point.
* In Xenon playthroughs, ZH.SyntheticDawnCompletion.xml will deallocate these arrays if the black market was not closed when the player joined the OCV.
* Transfer some sectors to the Yakis. Add-Ons 1.10.2: Reworked - now picks unknown sectors first, then non-core sectors.
* 1. Find a valid starting point. Conquer it and stock its Outpost.
* 2. Conquer adjacent commonwealth or unknown sectors using BFS.
* Stop if we reached target size.
* If normal frontier is empty, fall back to deferred active-sector frontier.
* Skip Renegade sector. Note that the Renegade sector is a dead-end sector, so no need to check for its neighbors since that'll point back to the previously visited sector!
* Conquer sector if not already Yaki. Stock its Outpost.
* Add to conquered list if not already present.
* Send message to the player. Just in case, only if there's at least 1 sector. Don't use yakiNbSectors since that's just the upper limit.
* Check if adjacent sector is already in the list.
* Defer player active sector until last resort.
